source_grounding.call_chain_traced: API layer validator (ignores dimension) → update_from_client spawns async task → segment layer checks dimension (only when wait=true executes synchronously). With wait=false, async task queues and returns Acknowledged immediately, skipping dimension validation.

verdicts.rationale: API accepts dimension-invalid vectors (empty vector []) when wait=false, returning 200 acknowledged instead of 4XX. Contract qdrant_behavioral_005 requires 4XX on validation error. Source analysis confirms: (1) API layer's validator::Validate trait only checks structural constraints, not business logic like dimension; (2) Dimension validation (WrongVectorDimension) is in segment layer; (3) When wait=false, update_from_client returns Acknowledged before segment validation runs. Wait=true correctly rejects with 400. Independent verification via GET /points confirms point was not inserted. This is a Type1_IllegalSuccess: invalid input succeeds with 200 instead of proper 4XX rejection.
